hooks.text: An asteroid sample was so huge it jammed its own lid.
How did collecting too much asteroid rock threaten a NASA mission?
Rocks jammed the lid open after OSIRIS-REx grabbed a massive asteroid surplus.

title: The Asteroid Sample That Was Too Successful
description: When OSIRIS-REx grabbed asteroid Bennu, it scooped up so much material that rocks jammed its lid open and pieces drifted into space.

beats.text: An asteroid sample was so huge it jammed its own lid.
beats.visual: Artist concept of OSIRIS-REx spacecraft near asteroid Bennu, NASA, 2020

beats.text: On October 20, 2020, the OSIRIS-REx probe touched down on asteroid Bennu to collect regolith.
beats.visual: Photograph of OSIRIS-REx TAGSAM arm touching asteroid Bennu surface, NASA, 2020

beats.text: Upon contact, a burst of nitrogen gas stirred up surface material into the sampler head.
beats.visual: Animation still of OSIRIS-REx nitrogen gas burst on asteroid Bennu, NASA, 2020
queries: Asteroid Bennu sample in TAGSAM head NASA

beats.text: The probe collected so much material that rocks jammed the sampler head's mylar flap open.
beats.visual: Photograph of OSIRIS-REx sample container with rocks overflowing, NASA, 2020
queries: OSIRIS-REx TAGSAM head rocks jammed mylar flap

beats.text: Valuable asteroid dust began escaping and drifting away into the vacuum of space.
beats.visual: Illustration of asteroid material escaping from OSIRIS-REx collector head, NASA, 2020
queries: Asteroid Bennu sample in TAGSAM head NASA

beats.text: Mission controllers canceled a spinning maneuver to weigh the sample and expedited stowing.
beats.visual: Photograph of mission control team at Lockheed Martin during OSIRIS-REx operations, 2020

beats.text: Despite the chaotic leak, the capsule brought home a record 121.6 grams of material.
beats.visual: Photograph of asteroid Bennu sample particles inside NASA clean room, 2023
queries: OSIRIS-REx sample first look NASA Johnson

beats.text: An asteroid sample was so huge it almost caused a total loss.
beats.visual: Photograph of OSIRIS-REx sample return capsule parachute landing in Utah, 2023
queries: OSIRIS-REx sample return capsule parachute Utah
